en.title: Project title
en.summary: One or two recruiter-friendly sentences explaining what the project does and why it matters.
en.challenge: Describe the user, operational, or technical problem that motivated the project.
contribution: Describe the most important feature or system you personally designed and built.
Describe another contribution that demonstrates ownership or delivery.
technical: Explain the implementation, important technology choices, and engineering constraints.
Explain testing, security, deployment, performance, or reliability decisions.

architecture.label: Experience
architecture.detail: Describe the user-facing interface or entry point.

architecture.label: Application
architecture.detail: Describe the core application or service layer.

architecture.label: Data & integrations
architecture.detail: Describe storage, APIs, models, queues, or external systems.

architecture.label: Delivery
architecture.detail: Describe testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational controls.

outcomes: Describe a concrete result, verified capability, or evidence without inventing metrics.

zh.title: 專案名稱
zh.summary: 用一至兩句適合招募者閱讀的繁體中文，說明專案功能與價值。
zh.challenge: 說明促成此專案的使用者、作業或技術問題。
contribution: 說明你親自設計與完成的主要功能或系統。
technical: 說明實作方式、重要技術選擇與工程限制。

architecture.label: 使用體驗
architecture.detail: 說明使用者介面或系統入口。

architecture.label: 應用層
architecture.detail: 說明核心應用程式或服務層。

architecture.label: 資料與整合
architecture.detail: 說明儲存、API、模型、佇列或外部系統。

architecture.label: 交付與維運
architecture.detail: 說明測試、部署、監控與操作控制。

outcomes: 說明具體成果、已驗證能力或可查證證據，避免虛構指標。
